adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the removeMember action (lines 51-57), the promise returned by `self.get('model').removeMember(member)` is not handled for rejection. Looking at the model's removeMember method in the diff, it makes an AJAX call that could fail. The bootbox.confirm callback calls removeMember but doesn't chain .catch() or handle errors, so if the API call fails, the user gets no feedback. This is a real defect - failed member removal would silently fail with no error shown to the administrator.
